items.title: One Accounting Core, Three ERPs: Odoo, Zoho Books and SAP

The same purchase produces the same journal entry in Odoo 18, Zoho Books and SAP Business One, and the arithmetic is tested once. 69 tests on the core, 12 more inside a real Odoo database.
